summary: sh shell options: admin_users, async_dir, common_remote_group for sharing temp files when becoming another user, remote_tmp, system_tmpdirs, and world_readable_temp.
questions: How do I change Ansible's remote temp directory on Linux?
Why does become to an unprivileged user fail with temp file permission errors?
Where are async job files stored on Linux?

answer_card.title: sh shell parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `remote_tmp` (`~/.ansible/tmp`), `async_dir` (`~/.ansible_async`)
- `admin_users` (`root`, `toor`)
- `common_remote_group`: if setfacl/chown fail when becoming another user, files are chgrp'd to this shared group
- `world_readable_temp` (false): make temp files world-readable (warns instead of failing)
- `system_tmpdirs` (`/var/tmp`, `/tmp`)
